_meta.title: Homepage marquees — brands and modules
_meta.description: Curated, decaf-relevant items for the two homepage marquees. The FE maps each item to its marquee and renders `label[locale]` plus an inline SVG chosen from the `icon` hint. `href` is an optional deep link.
_meta.iconVocabulary: Semantic icon names (lucide-style). FE owns the name -> inline SVG map; unknown names fall back to a neutral mark.
_meta.order: Array order is the intended display order; the marquee may duplicate the list to fill its track.
